column1: # ================ *** WHAT IT SAYS ABOUT KATHLEEN, WHICH IS THE POINT *** ================
# In 1911 she is in her sister's house, SINGLE, aged 41.
# In 1921 she is in her sister's house, aged 50, occupation *** "HOME INVALID". ***
# In 1939 she is in her sister's house, aged 68, occupation *** "INCAPACITATED". ***
# She died on *** 29 FEBRUARY 1940 *** - five months after this register was taken.
# *** TWENTY-EIGHT YEARS AT THE SAME ADDRESS, in the same sister's household, across three records and
# two wars. *** The eldest of ten children, and the only one of the ten who never left. This archive
# began with a bare line - "Kathleen Georgina Taylor, 4 Nov 1870 - 29 Feb 1940" and no husband - and
# read the blank as a question about marriage. *** It was never a question about marriage. ***
# And note what the Register does NOT say: the marital status column against her name is *** EMPTY ***,
# where Henry and Isabella are "Married" and the servant is "Single". Whether that is the enumerator's
# carelessness or something about how the household described her, it cannot be told from the page.
# *** Recorded as blank, not read as "single". ***
